name: Traditional Text (Kumbakonam, Bhīṣma Parva 25–42)
description: The Bhagavadgītā as it stands in the Kumbakonam Mahābhārata (T. R. Krishnacharya and T. R. Vyasacharya, 1906–10; SARIT text), Bhīṣma Parva adhyāyas 25–42. Verse numbers are those of the print. Speaker lines (arjuna uvāca, śrībhagavān uvāca) are shown above the verse they introduce.
citation: Bhagavadgītā, from the Mahābhārata, Kumbakonam edition (SARIT text)

name: Pune Critical Text (Bhīṣma Parva 23–40)
description: The Bhagavadgītā as reconstructed in the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute's critical Mahābhārata (Pune, 1933–66), Bhīṣma Parva adhyāyas 23–40, as digitised in GRETIL. Its 700 verses give the familiar Gītā numbering.
citation: Bhagavadgītā, from the Mahābhārata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune)
